title: Round 3 b: the FEIDS-26 drop on a timer from the radar with the owner's two lines, the streak's lore as an Isao brief, and the ending's skip asks first while the DAY 42 celebration replays with the scoreboard
context: Owner, 2026-10-26: '3) the unlock that makes the mech drop should be a timer from when we unlock the radar. a) "radar is built! We can ask for reinforcements!" ... after a few in-game days it arrives: "hmm these mechs were all they could send as support". 5) to explain "streaks" yielding more biomass, the lore is that when they die closer to each other, the dying cells of various organisms bound in a way that preserves more mass, otherwise it seeps into the ground. 8) when we see the final score after the cave, it is too easy to skip by mistake. a) we re-do a brief animation of the 42 days celebration, while the scoreboard also displays. If the user skips, we ask to confirm: "Skip End Game Celebration?"' Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-26-round-3-lines-lore-and-the-ending-design.md (decisions, kept where it is). Branch round-3-b from overnight-2026-10-23 0df35698, not pushed.
outcome: THE TIMER: src/domain/reinforcements.js dropReady now drops AT the due day (calledDay + REINFORCEMENTS.days 3, the day counter crossing it), held only by a manned seat, a card or Isao's panel (a running shot holds every case), never waiting for a lull; THE ARENA-first and ?reinforce rules unchanged. The host reports sinceDue, heldFor and lateBy. Isao's reinforcements_called = "Radar's up! We can ask the colony for reinforcements." / "I've sent the call. They'll take a few days to fall."; reinforcements_landed = "Hmm. These mechs were all they could send as support." / "Two hold the arena, one walks home, one hunts." (face curious), captions. Found on the base: the landed brief was never said (REINFORCEMENTS.briefs had no `landed`, so showBrief(undefined)); keyed now, and it waits REINFORCEMENTS.landedWait 30 s for a free panel instead of being dropped. THE STREAK'S LORE: BRIEFS.streak_lore (once, COMMS · ISAO, face curious: the set has no 'thinking') at 1.5x, the tenth kill of a streak: "When they die close together, their cells bind as they go. More of the mass holds." / "Alone, it just seeps into the ground. Keep the kills tight.", asked from td-tab noteStreak through the new brief-queue want(id, wait) (a beat that waits past the one-deep slot for a panel ending with nothing pending); the campaign debrief's 'longest streak' tile carries "kills close together hold more mass". The player meets streaks at the STREAK callout and that tile; the bestiary terminal has no scoring page, and the story's sector debrief has no streak tile (src/fx/campaign-debrief.js is the campaign board's debrief, not the story's). THE ENDING, mapped: the final sector secured -> sector-run finish, phase 'finale' -> descent-host begin (descent_brief, 2.5 s look at the arena's hole, the cave iframe shown once the brief is read, the game paused) -> the cave's outcome (descent_back or descent_last, held 7 s) -> ending-host finale: playDiorama (copies of the hull and Isao before the two rivalry boards, src/fx/scoreboard.js, celebrating; a non-live, unskippable 8 s shot) -> playOrbitalFinale (26 s on its own canvas, Isao's three lines at 1.2, 9.5 and 19.5 s, 'ANY KEY · SKIP': any key or tap ended it) -> the final sector's debrief card (src/fx/sector-debrief.js, five pages, the game paused: Space landed the reveal, the next closed it) -> the campaign card (THE COLONY HOLDS, four pages, NEW RUN / KEEP HOLDING). (a) src/domain/skip-confirm.js: the first key or tap asks, Space or a second tap within 4 s skips, any other key or 4 s of nothing keeps the celebration, a held key's repeats are ignored; the orbital finale's .of-skip line becomes "SKIP END GAME CELEBRATION? · SPACE YES · ANY OTHER KEY NO"; the ending's debrief card (the report after the finale and the campaign card, shown with { confirm: true }) asks in its footer hint before a press, Escape, ArrowRight or stray click lands a running page. (b) 'The board in the scene' is the diorama's rivalry boards, so the replay runs there: src/fx/disco-party.js replay() is a 20 s form apart from the party's clock (DAY_42.replay: no countdown, no lines, the ball up at once, the four floodlights, the laser ring and the track on its bus, the klaxon 3 s before the end, the ball lowered and shrunk away), and the diorama holds as long as it (20 s instead of 8), ticks it from its shot (the world's dt is 0 under it) and stops it at its end; the boards keep their scores. The ball hangs from the Stålheart's tip (the arm posed at once) when the ball there sits within 0.42 rad of the diorama's look from both ends of its rail, else 2 m over the boards' top: on the --finale route it hangs over the boards (the tip is out of the shot). state().ending.party, state().streak.
alternatives: Keeping the lull with a timer as its earliest moment: the owner asked for a timer, and the spec settled 'never for a lull'.

Running the replay under the final debrief card: the card's backdrop is 72-94 % opaque and the game is paused under it, so a party there would neither tick nor be seen; the diorama is where the boards stand in the scene.
Hanging the ball from the Stålheart's tip always: on the --finale route the tip is outside the diorama's frame, so the ball would play off screen.
Asking on the debrief card's close as well: the press after a landed reveal moves on to the campaign card, which is the same score; only cutting a running reveal short asks.
Retrying the lore on every kill through show(): measured, a 32-kill streak and no lore in 120 s while the panel cycled other beats (the one-deep slot dropped it each time).
evidence: npm test 305 programs (new: skip-confirm; brief-queue want, tdcore's lore check, reinforcements' timer rule, ending-host's eighth member), npm run check, npm run architecture (td-tab 5,325 under 5,450), npm run build: green on the final tree.

--reinforcements-timer (was --reinforcements-lull; port 18187): called on day 1, due day 4; a two-line brief put on the panel 2.4 game s before the day turned held the drop 5.07 game s past it; it dropped 5.08 s after the day turned, mid-fight (not a breath), 0.01 s after nothing held it; landed with the owner's line; with the sector quiet and its field cleared, 32 bodies beside two mechs gave a streak of 32 (2.6x) and the lore was said. PASS.

--finale: the replay at 2.5 s phase party over the boards, the ball hanging with 4 lights at 2.7 s, the klaxon at 17.11 s, done and gone when the constellation opens; a 'w' after Isao's third line shows the question and the finale goes on, Space then skips it at 21.2 s of its 26; Isao's three lines said. PASS. The track did not play headless (no gesture: music false).

--reinforcements: red twice on the first final tree at 'the Ridgebacks fire on bodies beside them' (no shot within 20 game s) and green on the base; measured, the first volley lands about 20 game s after the bodies are put down (20.4 s here, all four mechs in the same tick, the sector fighting), so the window is 45 game s; then PASS (touchdowns 13.03 / 13.46 / 14.03 / 19.23 s, the firing, the four up close, THE ARENA first).

--debrief: the whole step green, and the ending's card (labs.html#debrief, ending('secure'), { confirm: true }) asks on Space while the reveal runs, 'w' says no, Space then Space within 4 s lands the page with the card still open. PASS.
